reference_summary: I spent forty focused minutes sketching my neighbourhood zine and kept going by putting my phone away.
I let meetings and small jobs crowd out drawing, though I briefly practised a guitar chord more cleanly than yesterday.
Showing Sam my zine sketches helped me stop polishing too early and made the project feel more possible.
I got distracted by planning instead of drawing, then reduced tomorrow's work to finishing the rough layout.
I blocked out an uninterrupted hour, finished the rough layout for all eight pages, and felt relieved and proud.
I enjoyed an unhurried day cooking and playing cards with friends without feeling guilty about taking a break.
I used Sam's feedback to combine two pages, improve the zine, and found a concrete comment easier to act on than a blank page.
